安装 MyGit

1. 把 MyGit 拖进「应用程序」（Applications）文件夹。
2. MyGit 暂未经过 Apple 公证，第一次打开前，在「终端」里执行：

   xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine /Applications/MyGit.app

3. 打开 MyGit。之后它会自己更新，不用再执行这一步。


How to install MyGit

1. Drag MyGit into the Applications folder.
2. MyGit isn't notarized by Apple yet. Before opening it the first time, run
   this in Terminal:

   xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine /Applications/MyGit.app

3. Open MyGit. It updates itself from then on, without this step again.
